subject: Defer demo until fiscal approvals & CTO road trip complete
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@capstonehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot demo timing and capex gating

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for the time last week. We were planning a 45-minute pilot demo the week of June 7 to walk through the inference latency profiles and pilot SLOs, but two blockers surfaced on our side:

- Capstone’s procurement note about an upcoming capex review (I understand the committee meets the week of June 7)
- Your CTO’s road trip (you mentioned travel the first two weeks of June)

Given those constraints, I recommend we defer the live demo until after Capstone’s fiscal approvals land so the stakeholders who sign the PO can attend. If it helps momentum, we can run a short 20-minute technical dry run for your engineers next week (no sales deck, purely infra + network / VPC questions) — Ben can lead that.

Proposed next steps:
1) Hold the full demo until we confirm the capex decision (likely mid-July).
2) Book a 20-min dry run between your engineering lead and Ben (two windows below).
3) I’ll attach the current draft SOW and the MVP feature list for procurement review.

Available dry-run windows (PST):
- Tue Jun 1, 11:00–11:30
- Wed Jun 2, 14:00–14:30

Attachments: [Attachment: SOW_v0.9.pdf], [Attachment: MVP_feature_list.xlsx]

If you prefer to keep momentum with a smaller attendee list, tell me which of the two dry-run windows works and we’ll set it up.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

--

Appreciate the heads up and the proposed approach. Procurement and I are coordinating the capex packet; the committee actually moved the review to the week of July 12 because our CFO is out the first week of June. That means any demo that requires budget-holder attendance should happen after July 12.

A dry run for the engineering team makes sense to keep things moving. I’ve looped procurement so they see the draft SOW. Please include a PO template — I’ll need that to start our internal process.

Can you do Tue Jun 1 at 11:00 PST? If not, Wed Jun 2 at 14:00 will work but I’ll be on a plane and might drop off.

Given that, we’re happy to target a full demo week of Jul 13–15 so your CFO and procurement can attend.

Action items:
- Rishi: please share the finalized SOW for signature. I’ve uploaded the current SOW to DocuSign and started a placeholder envelope so procurement can preview terms: https://app.docusign.com/some/docusign-link-placeholder
- Marta / Procurement: if PO steps are standard, share your PO number template and we’ll slot it into the deal.
- Ben: capture the dry-run recording and post to the HubSpot deal (https://redwood.app/hubspot/deals/CAP-4789) so stakeholders who can’t join live can review.

We’ll treat Jul 13–15 as the tentative demo window and lock exact calendar times once Marta confirms attendee availability after the July 12 committee.

Thanks — happy to help move items along.
